obstacles: Actual raw frame and six kerf-right panel/kicker solids; 66 purchased-length panel screw axes; 12 retained frame-bolt axes; ideal nominal AB205 angle blocks

coincident_shared_row.nominal_straight_shaft_and_radial_probes: No solid collision from either Z approach on the four shared axes

conditional_distinct_row_midpoint.nominal_straight_shaft_and_radial_probes: Top row is clear from +Z and blocked from -Z by underside angle; underside row is clear from -Z and blocked from +Z by top angle

limits: The probes are not identified hardware, bolt heads, nuts, actual washers, a socket/wrench swing, hand clearance, or an assembly sequence. Factory bend radii, tolerances, installed fasteners, shoulder/thread position and loaded deflection remain unmodeled. Clear nominal probes do not verify service access after panel installation or justify a bolt length, joint rating or drilling layout.
